Alternative Fashion Styles.description: Fashion styles that exist outside of the mainstream, often associated with subcultures like Goth, Punk, and Emo.

Feminine Fashion Styles.description: Styles that emphasize traditionally feminine qualities, often characterized by soft colors, delicate fabrics, and romantic or glamorous silhouettes.

Lolita Fashion Styles.description: A Japanese street fashion subculture heavily influenced by Victorian and Edwardian clothing, known for its focus on modesty and cute, doll-like aesthetics.

Masculine Fashion Styles.description: Styles that emphasize traditionally masculine qualities, often characterized by structured silhouettes, durable fabrics, and functional or powerful aesthetics.

Streetwear Fashion Styles.description: A style of casual clothing worn by followers of popular culture, originating from skate and hip-hop culture and now encompassing elements of sportswear and high fashion.

Other General Styles.description: Broad fashion aesthetics or those not categorized under the other sub-styles.
